spec.scope: Self status window (Camouflage). The untargetability itself is defensive/inert in v1 (boss deals no damage), but the STATUS WINDOW is load-bearing because block 3 gates on it.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 5 (wall-clock). 'Removed upon taking a direct hit' never fires in v1 (no incoming damage), so windows run full 5s.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — 'Activates when using Burst Skill' is HER OWN burst cast (she is Burst II, cd 20s), NOT fullBurstEnter. Diverges whenever another Burst II shares the team (controlComp has crown at B2): on rotations where the other B2 takes the stage-2 cast, this must NOT fire.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter — Camouflage (and therefore the true-damage mode) opens on EVERY team Full Burst, including rotations she never bursts; over-credits the block-3 buffs.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Filter cfg.onEvent burstCast events by her srcSlot and the Camouflage-linked buffApply (trueDamagePct 42.24 self): every window's open frame coincides with HER burstCast, count(windows opened at FB entry without her cast) === 0, and no such buffApply exists before her first burst cast.
spec.inertness: No Camouflage-window buff at t=0; no window on a Full Burst she did not cast into.

spec.kitLine: ■ Full Charge during Full Burst → Camo 5s
spec.scope: Refresh path for the same Camouflage status: her full-charge attacks, only while a Full Burst is active. During FB she is normally on the burst swap weapon (0.3s charge, 1 ammo, 141f reload ≈ one full charge every ~2.7s), so Camouflage is effectively maintained through the FB window and lingers 5s past her last in-FB full charge.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 5, refreshed per qualifying full-charge attack (refresh, not stack).
spec.triggerIdentity: shotFired/full-charge attack with fbGate:'inFb'. NOT ungated: her base SR (chargeFrames 60 = 1s) full-charges constantly outside FB — ungating makes Camouflage near-permanent.
spec.nearestWrongModel: fbGate omitted — every out-of-FB SR full charge refreshes Camouflage, making the 42.24% true-damage mode permanent for the whole fight.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Pick a frame range outside Full Burst and >5s after her latest burstCast and after any FB window +5s: assert her damage events there carry NO trueDamagePct 42.24 contribution and no Camouflage buffApply is emitted by out-of-FB shots (cross-check inFullBurst=false on the triggering shot events).
spec.inertness: Out-of-FB full charges must not open/refresh Camouflage; total Camouflage uptime ≈ (per-burst 5s) + (FB windows + 5s tail), not 180s.

spec.scope: TWO effects, both self, both gated on live Camouflage: (a) normal attacks become TRUE-flavored; (b) True Damage ▲ 42.24% (trueDamagePct, Damage-Up bucket — boosts only true-flavored damage). Effect (a) is what makes (b) non-inert on her base-weapon shots: dropping the flavor conversion silently zeroes the 42.24% on normals. During the burst swap the swap itself is already true-flavored ('as true damage'), so the residual value of (a) is her base SR shots inside the 5s post-cast / post-FB-tail windows.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' = active exactly while Camouflage status is live; no independent duration.
spec.triggerIdentity: Status-gated self mode. The engine has no self-status gate primitive (requiresTargetStatus is boss-only), so faithful encoding is the equivalent construction: the two Camouflage-opening triggers apply 5s-durationSec effects (trueDamagePct buff + a true-normal flavor window), refreshed identically. Windows must be co-extensive with Camouflage.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Permanent passive — trueDamagePct 42.24 and true-flavored normals always on from t=0 (the 'continuously' word read as 'passive'), over-crediting all non-Camouflage uptime.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: A/B via withPatchedOverride: assert (1) her damage events inside a Camouflage window are true-flavored and larger than the same shot outside the window by the 42.24% Damage-Up factor; (2) at t=0 (before any burst) her normal shots are NOT true-flavored and carry no 42.24% buff; (3) totals(res)[slug] strictly increases when a Camouflage window is open vs a patched override with the block removed, with the delta confined to window frames.
spec.inertness: Zero effect on frames with no live Camouflage; zero effect on any teammate.

spec.scope: Generic critRatePct (no normal-attack scoping in the text), but the TARGET is squad-restricted: 'all allies from the same squad', not all allies. In the control comp (liter/crown/helm — no squad-mate), this resolves to self only.
spec.durationSemantics: 'continuously' + 'only when self survives' = permanent passive (nobody dies in v1).
spec.targetSet: same-squad allies (self included); effectively self in any comp without a squad-mate — the schema has no squad target kind, so faithful encoding is self (or teamHas.slugs-gated squad grants).
spec.nearestWrongModel: target {kind:'allies'} — 8.16% crit handed to liter/crown/helm/carry-mates, inflating the whole team's crit rolls.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Collect buffApply events with stat 'critRatePct' value 8.16: assert targetSlug === her slug only; assert no such buffApply with targetIdx of any other comp slot.
spec.inertness: Team members' crit rates unchanged by this line in a squad-mate-less comp.

spec.scope: chargeDamagePct — ADDITIVE percentage points in the charge bucket (not chargeDamageMultPct, which scales base charge damage). Benefits every charge-weapon ally (helm SR, her own SR + burst swap full charges).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Encoded as chargeDamageMultPct (base-charge multiplier) instead of additive chargeDamagePct — wrong bucket arithmetic; or scoped self-only.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply at frame 0 with stat 'chargeDamagePct' value 41.81 exists for ALL five comp slots (raw percentage value, per the flat-resolution note — plain % stats keep kit value); helm's charge-bucket damage in controlComp shifts when this block is stripped via withPatchedOverride.
spec.inertness: Non-charge damage buckets of non-charge allies unmoved.

spec.scope: Self ATK — atkPct (scales her own ATK), NOT casterAtkPct flat-add semantics.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Emitted as casterAtkPct (would flat-resolve to (42.24/100)×staticAtk on the buffApply and stack differently) or granted to allies.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'atkPct' value 42.24 (raw percentage, not a flat ATK number) with target self only; no ally slot receives it.

spec.kitLine: Bonus when LT Formation on self: E1 5.11%

spec.triggerIdentity: Externally-gated passive; the engine's closest primitive is a teamHas.slugs gate keyed to the LT-applier unit. With no LT applier in the comp (controlComp has none), the block is DEAD.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Gate dropped — the bonus modeled as an unconditional passive rider on skill2.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp assert there is NO buffApply with stat 'projectileExplosionPct' value 5.11 at any frame.
spec.inertness: Must contribute exactly zero in any comp lacking the LT-Formation applier.

spec.kitLine: Bonus when LT on self: True Dmg ▲30.97%
spec.scope: trueDamagePct ▲30.97 to all allies, same LT-Formation-on-self gate. THE high-stakes gating line: ungated it feeds HER OWN true damage (burst swap + Camouflage normals) a permanent +30.97 Damage-Up, a large over-credit.
spec.triggerIdentity: Externally-gated passive (teamHas.slugs on the LT applier); dead in any comp without that unit.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Gate dropped → permanent team-wide trueDamagePct 30.97, silently inflating every true-flavored hit she makes all fight.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: In controlComp assert NO buffApply with stat 'trueDamagePct' value 30.97 ever fires; her Camouflage-window true damage reflects only the 42.24 self buff (distinguishable by magnitude: the two values differ).
spec.inertness: Zero contribution without the LT applier; never conflated with the skill1 42.24 buff.

spec.scope: weaponSwap effect on burstCast: damagePct 105.6, chargeTimeSec 0.3, chargeMultPct 300 ('Full Charge damage: 300% OF DAMAGE' = ×3 on the 105.6, i.e. ~316.8% ATK per full charge — not +300 additive, not 300% of ATK), maxAmmo 1, trueNormals: true ('as true damage'). Shot economy: 0.3s charge + 141f (~2.35s) reload per single-round magazine ≈ one shot per ~2.7s. Every swap shot is a last bullet (no lastBullet lines in kit, so no consumer).
spec.durationSemantics: ⚑ SWAP DURATION IS KIT-SILENT — no 'for N sec' and no shot count is stated. This is ALWAYS-⚑ field (3), weapon-swap shot economy: flag with an estimate (10s FB-window convention) + recipe (footage: count swap shots / when her SR resumes), never ship silently.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (her own Burst II cast). Swap shots also satisfy the skill1 'Full Charge during Full Burst' refresh once FB opens (burst cast lands pre-FB per engine timing).
spec.nearestWrongModel: A single burstCast flatDamage nuke of ~316.8% instead of a live weaponSwap — loses the repeat-fire economy, the reload cadence, the Camouflage refresh feed, and the per-hit debuff reapplication; second-nearest: chargeMultPct misread as 300 percentage points additive charge damage.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: After her burstCast, assert MULTIPLE swap shot/damage events (≥2 within a 10s window, spaced ~2.5–3s by charge+reload), each true-flavored and charge-bucketed with mult consistent with 105.6×3, interleaved with reload events (maxAmmo 1 ⇒ reload after every shot) — a flatDamage encoding produces exactly one hit and no reloads.
spec.inertness: Base SR cadence/multiplier untouched outside the swap window.

spec.scope: 'Damage Taken ▲' on target(s) hit = BOSS DEBUFF (damageTakenPct 27.87, positive = boss takes more) benefiting the WHOLE TEAM's damage — taxonomy trap 4: not a self buff.
spec.durationSemantics: durationSec: 10, refreshed on each swap-shot hit; with ~2.7s between swap shots the window is continuous through the swap and lapses 10s after the last hit. buffRemove is NOT emitted on natural lapse — read expiresFrame off buffApply.
spec.triggerIdentity: On-HIT rider of the swap shots ('Target: Target(s) hit'), not on-cast: first application at the first swap shot's landing, one refresh per subsequent hit.
spec.targetSet: enemy (boss). Boss-held debuffs emit buffApply with casterIdx===null AND targetIdx===null — filter by stat+value.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Applied once at burst cast as a fixed 10s window (misses the per-hit refresh chain, undercounting uptime), or worst-case modeled permanent / as a self damage buff.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Collect buffApply stat 'damageTakenPct' value 27.87 with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null: assert count === swap shots landed per burst (cast-once encoding gives exactly 1), first application aligns with the first swap DAMAGE event (not the burstCast event), and ALLY damage events inside the debuff window scale up vs an identical frame outside it.
spec.inertness: No debuff uptime before her first burst; no uptime beyond lastHit+10s.

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads to reconcile hardest: (1) Camouflage as ALWAYS-ON — 'continuously' in the block-3 text tempts a permanent passive; faithful uptime is only (per-own-burst 5s) + (FB full-charge chain + 5s tail). (2) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on skill1 block 1: controlComp carries crown at Burst II alongside her, so first-ready stage-2 selection makes the two encodings genuinely diverge — a fullBurstEnter encoding over-credits every rotation she loses the B2 cast. (3) Dropping the 'Normal attacks deal true damage' FLAVOR conversion: trueDamagePct is a flavor-scoped Damage-Up stat, so without the conversion the 42.24 buff is silently inert on her base-weapon shots — assert flavor on the damage events, not just buff presence. (4) The LT-Formation bonus block ungated: +30.97 team trueDamagePct permanently inflating her own true damage is the single largest plausible over-credit in this kit; nothing in HER kit applies LT Formation, so in controlComp both bonus effects must be provably absent. (5) Swap duration is the one genuinely kit-silent economy value — ⚑ mandatory (estimate 10s FB-window convention; verify via swap-shot count/SR-resume in footage). (6) 'Full Charge damage: 300% of damage' is a multiplier on the swap's own 105.6, not additive charge% and not 300% of ATK. Also note maxAmmo 1 makes every swap shot a last bullet — kit has no last-bullet consumer, but any generic last-bullet machinery must not misfire. Engine-primitive caveat for the driver: there is no self-status gate in the schema (requiresTargetStatus is boss-only), so Camouflage must be encoded as co-extensive 5s-refresh windows on the two opening triggers; the tests should pin window EDGES (open at her cast / at in-FB full charges; closed elsewhere) rather than any named status.
